title: Test follow-ups after GCLI-55/58: restore env in hostile parity tests, fix flush-proof comment
description: Test-only follow-up to GCLI-55 and GCLI-58: restore process.env.GLYPH_CACHE_DIR in the hostile parity tests' finally; split the two fallback-control loops into one test per fixture; correct the flush-proof comment (bun's 5 s default is the real limit, headroom about 2x). Check can still flake under load. No timeout is raised.
implementationNotes: 2026-11-23 junit run (bun test parity+stream, 20 busy shell loops, dev 4cf670e plus GCLI-63 comment edits): slowest test 2.48 s (parity 'fallback is a true control: an absent index'), then flush proof 2.39 s, 2.30 s; every other test 2.03 s or less, so the AC bound (2.5 s) holds with 0.02 s to spare on the worst. Headroom to bun's 5 s default is about 2x; Check can still flake under heavier load. No timeout was raised. One test per command / per fixture is visible in the junit names.

Timing run 2026-11-23, 20 busy shell loops, 3 runs of parity+stream+cli junit at the head with the finally change and the split fallback controls: parity slowest 1.43-1.53 s, stream slowest 2.35-2.44 s (flush proof, inherent 1.5 s pause), cli.test.ts 'every successful --json invocation' 3.72-3.76 s (hot spot, out of scope, left alone). Headroom to bun's 5 s default for the stream file is about 2x; Check can still flake. No timeout was raised. The earlier one-run note (2.48 s worst) is superseded.
